detailed_description: The Line Chart Generator helps you turn ordered values into a clean trend chart directly in your browser. It is a simple way to show movement across time, stages, or ranked categories when you want viewers to focus on direction and change. You can edit labels and values, tune the title, colors, legend, and markers, then review the live preview before exporting the chart as PNG or SVG for reports, documentation, or product updates.
usage_steps: Enter your labels and values in the editor, or start with the sample data on the page.
Set the chart title and confirm the labels appear in the order you want to present.
Adjust line colors, markers, and legend visibility so the chart is easy to scan.
Check the preview and refine the data or labels where the line feels cluttered.
Export the final line chart as PNG or SVG once the visual matches your message.
usage_examples: Show monthly traffic, signups, or revenue in a weekly or monthly performance report.
Track bug count or response time changes across several releases.
Visualize progress through a funnel or roadmap sequence in internal documentation.
